description: This file defines the EntityCount class, which implements the <entity-count> element for the OFBiz mini-language. It performs entity count operations with optional conditions and provides methods for execution, artifact info gathering, and string representation.

classes.name: EntityCount
classes.description: Implements the <entity-count> element, performing count queries with optional conditions and providing execution and artifact info methods.

classes.name: EntityCountFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating EntityCount instances from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the entity count operation, applying optional where and having conditions, and stores the result in the specified count field.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information, specifically the entity name used.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EntityCount object.
